core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khola corresponds to the Arabic form خولة (Arabic خَوْلَة (Khawla)). Its core sense is khawla; a female given name. Khola is a variant transliteration of Arabic خَوْلَة (Khawla), a well-documented female given name borne by Khawla bint al-Azwar. The source gloss 'Moon, Night' is unsupported; the name is a proper name. Same name as khaula, khawla and khawlah.
